source: HP Maintenance and Service Guides, found via support.hp.com → product number → Setup & User Guides

otto.title: HP 15.6 inch Laptop PC — Model 15-fc0xxx
otto.ram: Upgradeable – 2 SODIMM slots (DDR4-3200, up to 16 GB)
otto.ramNote: Guide: Ryzen 7 7730U / Ryzen 5 7530U models have two SODIMM slots supporting up to 16 GB (DDR4-3200, dual channel). Models with 7520U/7320U/7220U/7120U use onboard memory instead — not applicable to these SKUs.
otto.ssd: 1× M.2 SSD slot (2280 PCIe NVMe; 2230 also listed) – no additional M.2 SSD slot listed
otto.ssdNote: Only a primary storage M.2 SSD is listed (one SSD removal procedure).

sebastian.title: HP 15.6 inch Laptop PC — Model 15-fd1xxx
sebastian.ram: Upgradeable – removable SODIMM modules (DDR4-3200, up to 32 GB; up to 2 modules)
sebastian.ramNote: Guide lists DDR4-3200 configurations up to 32 GB, incl. 2 × 8 GB, and a memory-module removal procedure. Number of slots not specified in HP Service Guide.
sebastian.ssd: 1× M.2 SSD slot (2280 PCIe NVMe) – no additional M.2 SSD slot listed
sebastian.ssdNote: Only a primary storage M.2 SSD is listed.

abei.title: HP OmniBook 3 14 inch Laptop (AI PC) — 14-hy0xxx/14-hu0xxx, 14-ht0xxx
abei.ram: Upgradeable – removable DDR5-5600 SODIMM module(s), up to 32 GB
abei.ramNote: Guide lists removable DDR5-5600 memory modules (8/16/24/32 GB) and describes system memory as 'SODIMM socket, removable'. Number of slots not specified in HP Service Guide. (The guide also covers LPDDR onboard-memory models; these SKUs use DDR5 SODIMM per the pricelist spec.)
abei.ssd: 1× M.2 SSD slot (2280 PCIe Gen4 NVMe) – no additional M.2 SSD slot listed
abei.ssdNote: Only a primary storage M.2 2280 SSD is listed.

deso.ramNote: Guide: 'Memory is onboard, not accessible or upgradeable.'
deso.ssd: 1× M.2 SSD slot (2280 PCIe NVMe) – no additional M.2 SSD slot listed
deso.ssdNote: Only a primary storage M.2 2280 SSD is listed.

kento.title: HP OmniBook X Flip 14 inch 2-in-1 Next Gen AI PC — 14-kc0xxx, 14-kb0xxx
kento.ramNote: Guide: 'Memory is not accessible or upgradeable' — LPDDR5X onboard memory.

fn.title: HP OmniBook 3 15.6 inch Next Gen AI PC — 15-fn0xxx
fn.ram: 2 SODIMM slots (DDR5-5600, up to 32 GB) – not customer upgradeable
fn.ramNote: Guide: 'Two SODIMM slots supporting up to 32 GB of RAM (not customer accessible or upgradeable).' Memory changes are for authorized service providers.
fn.ssd: 1× M.2 SSD slot (2280 PCIe NVMe) – no additional M.2 SSD slot listed
fn.ssdNote: Only a primary storage M.2 2280 SSD is listed.

envy.title: HP ENVY 16 Notebook PC — 16-h00xxx (guide linked by HP for 86J71PA)
envy.ram: Upgradeable – 2 SODIMM slots (DDR5-4800, up to 32 GB)
envy.ramNote: Guide: 'Two customer-accessible memory module slots (SODIMMs) supporting up to 32 GB of RAM.' Caution: this is the guide HP links for 86J71PA, but it names model 16-h00xxx (12th Gen); 16-h1xxx is not listed in it.
envy.ssd: 1× M.2 SSD slot (2280 PCIe Gen4 NVMe) – no additional M.2 SSD slot listed
envy.ssdNote: Only a primary storage M.2 2280 SSD is listed. Same caution as memory (guide names 16-h00xxx).

af.title: HP OmniBook 5 16 inch 16-af1xxx/16-ba1xxx & HP Pavilion 16 inch 16-af0xxx
af.ramNote: Guide: 'Integrated system memory' (LPDDR5/LPDDR5X); system-board spare kits include the memory; no memory-module removal procedure.
af.ssd: 1× M.2 SSD slot (2280 PCIe Gen4 NVMe) – no additional M.2 SSD slot listed
af.ssdNote: One SSD removal procedure (Table 6-2); no secondary storage listed.

ag.title: HP OmniBook 5 16 inch Next Gen AI PC 16-ag1xxx/16-bc1xxx & HP Pavilion 16 inch 16-ag0xxx
ag.ramNote: Guide: 'Integrated system memory' (LPDDR5/LPDDR5X); system-board spare kits for the Ryzen 5 8540U include 8/16 GB of system memory; no memory-module removal procedure.
ag.ssd: 1× M.2 SSD slot (2280 PCIe Gen4 NVMe) – no additional M.2 SSD slot listed
ag.ssdNote: One SSD removal procedure (Table 6-2); no secondary storage listed.
